ARCLUME STUDIO / THE DETAILS

Privacy policy

A clear explanation of what happens to your information on this website.

Updated September 14, 2026

Private preview · Draft for business review. Legal business details and the contact address must be confirmed before public launch.

Who this notice is about

This notice describes the Arclume Studio website. The legal business identity, operating location and privacy contact are awaiting confirmation in this private preview.

Your project inquiry

The inquiry form asks for your name, email address, service of interest and project idea, with an optional business name or website. While online inquiries are unavailable, the Send inquiry button is disabled and these details are not submitted.

When connected, clicking Send inquiry transmits your answers to Formspree, our form processing provider, so the studio can receive and respond to your inquiry. Formspree may process technical information to deliver the service and filter spam. Its privacy policy describes its practices. A confirmation appears only after the form service acknowledges acceptance; it does not mean the studio has read your inquiry.

The page does not deliberately save your answers in browser storage. Your browser may retain form entries through its own autofill or session features. If a submission fails or cannot be confirmed, answers remain in the open page so you can retry. Reloading or leaving the page may lose them.

How inquiries are used

Received details are used to understand and respond to your project, discuss a proposal and manage related correspondence. Sending an inquiry does not subscribe you to marketing emails. If you use a direct email link, your email application opens and you must send that message yourself.

Do not include passwords, payment card information or sensitive personal information in a project inquiry.

Website delivery and technical information

The hosting service may process technical information such as your IP address, browser information and request logs to deliver and protect the website. Access to this private preview may also require the hosting platform’s sign-in. Those platform processes are separate from the project brief.

Arclume’s page code does not currently include advertising pixels, analytics tools, embedded social feeds or remote fonts. Images, scripts and styles are served with the site. Read the cookie notice for details.

Other websites

When active social profile links are added, following one will take you to another provider. Its privacy practices apply to your visit there. A “Coming soon” label is not an active link.

Retention, access and correction

When submissions are enabled, received inquiries may be stored in the form provider’s dashboard and the studio inbox. The business must confirm its retention schedule and request process before enabling direct submissions. Where applicable law provides rights to access, correct or request deletion of information held by the business, those requests should be directed to the verified privacy contact.

Security

The hosted website uses HTTPS. When connected, the inquiry form transmits answers to the form provider over HTTPS. No online service or device can be guaranteed completely secure; protect downloaded briefs and use trusted email and devices when sharing them.

Updates and contact

This notice will be updated when contact handling, service providers, analytics or other data practices change.

The studio’s contact address is being finalized for this private preview. A verified address for privacy requests and other inquiries will be published before the site opens to the public.
